fields.description:
Scratch ticket for the 0.16.0 hand-verification of the selectable plan-review engine (ADR 0123). It exists so `review_plan_start` can be exercised on the production MCP server under both engines; it will be closed as obsolete afterwards and its plan is not intended to be implemented.

## Context / Problem
`resolve_plan_review_engine` in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py` refuses an explicit engine outside `PLAN_REVIEW_ENGINES` with `ConfigError`. `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py` pins the default, the config key and the ignored environment variable, but no test pins that the comparison is case-sensitive, so a change that lower-cased the argument would go unnoticed.

## Approach
Add one parametrized test to `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py` that calls `resolve_plan_review_engine` with `"Agentic"`, `"PIPELINE"` and `" pipeline"` and asserts each raises `rebar.config.ConfigError` whose message names the rejected value. No source change, and no existing test is modified.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py`: add `test_explicit_engine_is_case_and_whitespace_sensitive`.

Out of scope: config-file values (already validated by `_as_choice` in `src/rebar/_config_sections.py`).

## Testing
Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py -q`. Happy path: the existing tests still pass. Failure path: each of the three values raises `ConfigError`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py` defines `test_explicit_engine_is_case_and_whitespace_sensitive`, parametrized over `"Agentic"`, `"PIPELINE"` and `" pipeline"`, asserting `ConfigError` with the value in its message.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_engine_switch.py -q` exits 0.
